text:
Ava: Quick spike UI idea: show a compact "current-state" chip that combines mode, sample %, and 'reason' summary. Operators should be able to click the chip to get a 1-click override dropdown.

Carlos: Love the chip. For overrides: require an optional short note always, but enforce a mandatory note if override > 15m. Helps postmortems.

Priya: We already debated 10m; 15m seems reasonable. Also: the drilldown should include a micro-playback that replays the trigger window (30s before -> 2min after) inline. No full log hops.

Marta: Practical ask: can the playback highlight the exact sample of requests that were redirected, and show a tiny scatter of p95 vs qps? That would help correlate load vs latency quickly.

Ava: Yes. UI sketch: left column = chip + last 3 trigger badges, middle = small timeline + playback scrubber, right = quick actions (force-mode, set cooldown, set TTL).

rollout-bot: saved_policy: id=pol_1723, auto_switch=true, modes=[observe,soft_redirect,full_redirect], triggers=[p95>1100ms,errors>4%]

Carlos: Telemetry suggestion: event name rollout.switch_event with keys {policy_id,old_mode,new_mode,trigger_type,trigger_value,operator,override_reason,event_id}. Keep consistent with logging pipeline.

Priya: UX note: show cost delta badge when redirecting (low/med/high) with a hover tooltip that shows an estimate like "~+12k tokens/day if fully redirected". PMs will like that.

Marta: Edge case: multiple simultaneous triggers (latency+errors). Display priority: show the dominant trigger (highest severity) but allow expanding to see both.

Ava: For hysteresis, I'm prototyping 45s default + a 2x backoff on repeated flips. We'll expose hysteresis_s and cooldown_s fields in the API.

Priya: Draft policy preview for console (read-only unless 'edit' chosen):
```json
{"id":"pol_1723","auto_sw":true,"modes":{ "observe":{"sampling":0.002,"hysteresis_s":45},"soft_redirect":{"sampling":0.02,"redirect_pct":30,"min_duration_s":90},"full_redirect":{"sampling":1.0,"redirect_pct":100,"min_duration_s":300}},"triggers":[{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":"gt","value":1100},{"metric":"error_rate_pct","op":"gt","value":4}],"cooldown_s":180 }
```

Carlos: When an operator forces 'soft_redirect' we should tag event.operator and event.override_reason in telemetry so audits know who did what. Also add event.action_ttl to record intended override expiry.

Marta: On the playback side, include a tiny "replay in sandbox" action that forwards the original payloads to a sandboxed model instance for local repro. That needs RBAC checks though.

Ava: Good call. RBAC: only SRE+Platform leads can trigger sandbox replays. Show disabled button with tooltip for others.

rollout-bot: telemetry_registered: event=rollout.switch_event, fields=[policy_id,old_mode,new_mode,trigger,trigger_value,operator,override_reason,event_id,action_ttl]

Priya: I'll implement the chip + playback mock in Figma and add the API change request (fields: hysteresis_s, cooldown_s, action_ttl, operator_note). I'll add a note to require operator_note for manual overrides >900s.

Carlos: Sounds good. I'll follow up on the telemetry naming in a short PR to standardized events.

Marta: I'll draft the minimal RBAC rules and check sandbox quotas.

Ava: Thanks team. I'll open a design PR tomorrow with the mock and the tiny interaction prototype. Ping me if you want to pair on the playback UX.
